The '''2019–20 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas Christian University]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]], led by head coach [[Jamie Dixon]] in his fourth season at TCU. The Horned Frogs competed as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]] and played their home games at [[Schollmaier Arena]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]].

== Previous season ==
They finished the season 23–14, 7–11 in [[2018–19 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2018–19 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] as the No. 1 seed where they lost in the semifinals to [[2017–18 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]].
